WITH supplier_order_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    s.s_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS distinct_order_count
  FROM supplier s
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
  WHERE r.r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1998-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1999-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.s_name
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(distinct_order_count) AS avg_orders
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      s.s_name,
      COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS distinct_order_count
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1998-01-01'

    GROUP BY s.s_name
  )
)
SELECT

  sco.distinct_order_count
FROM supplier_order_counts sco

WHERE sco.distinct_order_count > ga.avg_orders

        SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spend
    FROM customer c

SELECT

        WHEN total_spend < 100000 THEN 'Bucket 1'
        WHEN total_spend >= 100000 AND total_spend < 300000 THEN 'Bucket 2'
        WHEN total_spend >= 300000 AND total_spend < 1000000 THEN 'Bucket 3'
        WHEN total_spend >= 1000000 THEN 'Bucket 4'
    END AS spending_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customer_spending
GROUP BY spending_bucket
ORDER BY spending_bucket ASC

```sql
WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT
        n.n_name,
        c.c_name,
        c.c_custkey,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_net_spending
    FROM customer c
    JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY'
        AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
    GROUP BY n.n_name, c.c_name, c.c_custkey
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        n_name,
        c_name,
        total_net_spending,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n_name ORDER BY total_net_spending DESC, c_name ASC) AS spending_rank
    FROM customer_spending
)
SELECT
    n_name,
    c_name,
    ROUND(total_net_spending, 2) AS total_net_spending,
    spending_rank
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE spending_rank <= 3
ORDER BY n_name ASC, spending_rank ASC;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS order_year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.o_orderdate) AS order_month,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#12'
      AND l.l_shipmode = 'AIR'
      AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.o_orderdate)
),
monthly_with_change AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        order_month,
        total_revenue,
        CASE
            WHEN LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month) IS NULL THEN 0.00
            ELSE ((total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month)) / LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month)) * 100
        END AS mom_percentage_change
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    order_month,
    ROUND(total_revenue, 2) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(mom_percentage_change, 2) AS mom_percentage_change
FROM monthly_with_change
ORDER BY order_year ASC, order_month ASC

    l.l_shipmode,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS returned_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag != 'R' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS kept_revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
FROM 
    lineitem l
JOIN 
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN 
    part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE 
    o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01' 
    AND o.o_orderdate <= '1994-12-31'
    AND p.p_brand = 'Brand#52'
GROUP BY 
    l.l_shipmode
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY 
    (returned_revenue + kept_revenue) DESC, 
    l.l_shipmode ASC
```
